title: unified-rollouts: staged canary + shadow + A/B autorollback workflows
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: Improve safety and observability for model rollouts by composing staged canary, shadow probing, and A/B experiments into a unified workflow with automatic rollback on multi-metric regressions. This PR implements the orchestration glue, integrates the autorollback engine with rollout controller, and adds observability and e2e tests.

Summary of changes: implements staged_canary workflow (weight scheduling + probe windows), shadow probing hook (non-disruptive probing and metric tagging), A/B traffic split helpers, multi-metric autorollback policy evaluation and quarantine stage, improved rollback telemetry and dashboards, and documentation + migration guide.

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation of staged canary workflow and scheduler
- [x] Shadow probing integration with metric tagging and KV for sample tracing
- [x] A/B split helpers and route plumbing
- [x] Autorollback engine integration (multi-metric + quorum) with safety guards
- [x] Observability: rollback metrics, traces, and per-rollout dashboards updated
- [x] E2E tests covering staged canary with shadow probing and rollback
- [x] Docs and migration guide updated
- [x] Performance verification on Dedicated (internal perf run)

Migration notes: existing rollouts that use the legacy canary path will continue to function; operators can opt-in to the new staged_canary workflow via the rollout spec (field: rollout.strategy: staged_canary). The migration guide in docs highlights config differences and recommended probe metrics.

How tested: unit tests, integration tests in CI, manual QA on staging with synthetic traffic, and a canary deployment to a dedicated internal cluster with simulated multi-metric regressions. CI initially showed a flaky integration test that was stabilized by increasing the probe timeout; the run after the fix passes.

Context & references: ENG-2034 (design), PM-411 (product constraints), SUP-8821 (customer incident that motivated quarantine stage).
commits_summary: 5 commits: initial staged_canary workflow scaffolding; add shadow probing hook and metric tagging; integrate autorollback engine + safety guards; add e2e tests and telemetry; docs and migration guide.
review_comments: Ethan Park: Can we add a TTL on KV entries created by shadow_probe to avoid unbounded growth? (suggested 24h)
Priya Nair: Added TTL and GC in shadow_probe; default 24h but configurable via rollout.spec.hooks.shadow.kv_ttl.
Sofia Martinez: The multi-metric quorum logic looks good; one nit about weighting when some metrics are missing — prefer explicit fallback to baseline instead of dropping the metric.
Priya Nair: Updated quorum evaluator to fallback to baseline with documented rationale and added unit tests for missing-metric cases.
Rafael Ortega: Observability changes are extensive — please add an example dashboard and link to runbook for on-call response to autorollback events.
Priya Nair: Added dashboard JSON and a short runbook section in docs.
ci_checks: ci/e2e: pass (requires dedicated cluster; run in gating environment)
merge_commit_message:
unified-rollouts: staged canary + shadow + A/B autorollback workflows

Implements staged canary scheduler, shadow probing integration, A/B split helpers, and autorollback engine wiring. Adds observability, e2e tests, and migration docs.

Refs: ENG-2034, PM-411, SUP-8821
release_notes: Add staged canary + shadow probing + A/B rollout workflows with multi-metric autorollback and safety guards. Operators can opt in via rollout.strategy: staged_canary. Includes observability dashboards and a migration guide.
risk_assessment: Medium: introduces new orchestration paths and integrations with autorollback engine. Safety guards (quarantine stage, multi-metric quorum, manual override) included to limit blast radius. Recommend enabling on non-critical services first and monitoring runway metrics for 72h.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover quorum/evaluator and eviction paths. Integration tests exercise probe timeouts and rollback decisioning. E2E validates end-to-end staged canary with simulated metric regressions on staging. Dedicated perf run shows latency impact < 1% at 99th percentile under normal traffic.
